description.value:
Requirement A substantial quantity of scrap, machinery, or wreckage is available.

Duration permanent

Rebuild your destroyed Rig from whatever is to hand. It returns at full Hit Points, at its current Mk tier, with every mod and binding it had when it was destroyed. You need no workshop and no tools. Nothing is lost but the hour.

cinderfall.incomplete: [RIG-NO-ACTOR]/[RIG-GENERIC-AMBIGUOUS] -- restoring "the Rig's" HP/tier/mods presupposes those are tracked game-state values (true only if Rig = a companion actor, which doesn't exist); for Iron Lung/Widowmaker there's no "destroyed gear" state machine either. Not purely narrative (it references concrete restorable data), so INCOMPLETE rather than SKIP.
